query:
SELECT t.id
           FROM technician t
           WHERE t.dealership_id = $1
             AND $2 = ANY (t.skills)
             AND NOT EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1 FROM appointment a
                 WHERE a.technician_id = t.id
                   AND a.status = 'confirmed'
                   AND a.slot && tstzrange($3, $4, '[)'))
           ORDER BY t.id
